note: Values Auto and the dev Autofill pick for each lifepath stage, so a generated value reflects the stage that grants it. Original prototype text, not from Captain's Log: the book only gives the 20 general sample values of the Values Matrix (p.90) plus a prompt per stage (Education valueText per option; Finishing Touches p.129: 'might reflect the career events'). Players still choose from the Values Matrix or write their own on screen. Keyed by education option id and career event id (the final value draws from the character's two events). Draft copy for designer review. Where the STA 2E Core Rulebook gives examples, Auto uses those instead of this file (rules/stageValues.js): Environment draws on the species' sample values (Core pp.100-113 sidebars, data/source/speciesValues.json) and Experience on the Novice / Veteran examples (Core pp.127-128, data/source/careerLengths.json valueExamples); with none (e.g. Experienced, or a species the book doesn't cover) Auto picks from the book's Sample Values (Core p.96).
educationNote: Unlike the other stages, these are book text: Core's example values per Career Path (pp.121-126), matching valueExamples in source/education.json.
